content.short: Exchange Art is a Solana-based fine art NFT marketplace with auctions, on-chain verifications, and a 2.5% sale fee.
content.description: Launched by Alex Fleseriu, Exchange Art is an NFT marketplace built on the Solana blockchain. Users can browse by art categories, bid in auctions, and verify tokens and on-chain ownership changes. Developers can list collections and leverage the Royalties Protection Standard provided by the platform. Exchange Art also enables artists to reach a global audience, offering artwork sales at a fraction of traditional gallery costs: just 2.5% per sale, versus the usual 50–70%.
